criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/ holds exactly eight skill folders: create-brief, gate-review, operate, plan, review, review-brief, verify, work. plugin/skills/create-brief/ holds exactly SKILL.md, guidelines.md and templates/ (with brief-en.md and brief-es.md); plugin/skills/review-brief/ holds exactly SKILL.md.
criteria.evidence: find shows create-brief with SKILL.md, guidelines.md, templates/brief-en.md, brief-es.md; review-brief with SKILL.md only; the updated B7 e2e test pins the eight names and the go check passes

criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/create-brief/guidelines.md, templates/brief-en.md and templates/brief-es.md are byte for byte the files under .claude/skills/vloop-create-brief/; the .claude/skills/ project copies are left in place, unchanged.
criteria.evidence: cmp reports the three files identical; git status shows no change under .claude

criteria.criterion: Line 2 of the two SKILL.md files is `name: create-brief` and `name: review-brief`; each `description` is the original one with its leading "Experimental, not yet in the plugin — " dropped and the rest kept. No file under plugin/skills/ contains vloop-create-brief, vloop-review-brief, "experimental" or "not yet in the plugin" (case-insensitive).
criteria.evidence: diff against originals shows the name lines and the description prefix (lowercase first letter) as the only frontmatter changes; case-insensitive grep over plugin/skills finds nothing

criteria.criterion: create-brief's SKILL.md names /vloop:review-brief for the independent review (its step 5) and /vloop:operate for marking ready and running (its step 6). review-brief's SKILL.md names /vloop:create-brief as the skill briefs are written with, and its standard as the guidelines.md beside /vloop:create-brief's SKILL.md (../create-brief/guidelines.md from its folder).
criteria.evidence: create-brief/SKILL.md:108 names /vloop:review-brief and :125 /vloop:operate; review-brief/SKILL.md:14 names /vloop:create-brief and ../create-brief/guidelines.md

criteria.criterion: create-brief's step 5.1 says to copy the brief, under the same file name, into a temporary directory outside docs/briefs/, because vloop brief check compares the file name with the brief's name. A violation the review must rule on: any other change to either skill's instructions beyond the name, the description's prefix, the skill pointers and this step — the move is a move.
criteria.evidence: create-brief/SKILL.md lines 101-104 carry the required wording; the full diffs against both originals show only the name, description prefix, pointers and step 5.1

criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/operate/SKILL.md's frontmatter description ends `Writing briefs is /vloop:create-brief's.` in place of `Writing briefs is not this skill's job.`; nothing else in that file changes, and no other existing skill's file changes.
criteria.evidence: git diff HEAD --stat -- plugin shows only operate/SKILL.md, 1 line changed, the description's last sentence

criteria.criterion: internal/budget/budget.go: Skills is plan, gate-review, work, review, operate, verify, create-brief, review-brief, in that order; Ceilings gains "create-brief": 1200 and "review-brief": 1000, each with the comment `// 2026-11-02, B28 (#101): its size when it joined the plugin, plus headroom`; the other ceilings are unchanged. budget.Check on a plugin whose create-brief SKILL.md is padded to 1201 words reports `create-brief: 1,201 words, over its ceiling of 1,200`.
criteria.evidence: budget.go diff shows the order, the two ceilings and the exact comments; other ceilings keep their values (gofmt realignment only); TestCheckCreateBriefOverCeiling asserts the exact message. Sizes are 1085 and 901 words, under the ceilings

criteria.criterion: With a binary built from the tree: `vloop fence check --phase review --root . --tool skill --path review-brief` prints allow and exits 0; with `--path vloop-review-brief` it prints `deny: skill vloop-review-brief is not vloop's — use /vloop:review` and exits 1; `vloop plugin path` in a freshly initialised repository extracts a plugin whose skills/create-brief/templates holds brief-en.md and brief-es.md. These follow from the embedded plugin's skill list: no change to internal/fence, internal/driver, the fences or vloop brief new/check.
criteria.evidence: No diff in internal/fence or internal/driver; the behaviour follows from the embedded plugin's skill list, and the plugin dir now has the templates. I did not run the binary myself; the gate and the go check passed

criteria.criterion: vloop doctor in a repository with agent.review = copilot, a stub copilot and a .claude/skills/review-brief/ folder exits 1 and prints `✗ .claude/skills/review-brief has the name of vloop's review-brief skill; a copilot session may load it instead — rename it`.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor_copilot_review_brief_test.go asserts exit 1 and that exact line; the go check passed

criteria.criterion: Committed tests, run by the `go` check, cover the new behaviour: a budget test that pads create-brief past 1,200 words and expects the message above, and a doctor test in internal/cli (as internal/cli/doctor_copilot_plan_test.go) for the review-brief clash line. A task that leaves neither behind is a violation. TestPluginSkills passes on the plugin with the two new skills, no structural check weakened.
criteria.evidence: Both tests are added and assert the exact strings. skills_test.go is untouched and the go check exits 0

criteria.criterion: TestWorkedExampleB7PluginPath in cmd/vloop/b7_e2e_test.go is changed to the eight skill names and nothing else; the work notes name the contract item (K1, the eight folders) and that this is the only earlier test changed.
criteria.evidence: The diff changes only the expected-name string and the message in that test. The proposal notes cite K1, the eight folders
